# 2026-05-26 Live Incident Fixtures

Sanitized fixture set for the residual repair and recovery incidents observed on
2026-05-26. These files contain only non-secret state, normalized quantities,
symbols, venues, public exchange classifications, and event payload fields needed
by offline harness tests.

They must not contain API keys, signatures, account IDs, or unrelated production
journal excerpts. Real exchange validation belongs in `tests/probes/` and must
remain read-only.
